# Draft:The James Howard

References
The James Howard is a non-alcoholic mixed drink traditionally made with a frozen blend of 60% Coca-Cola and 40% Fanta, with a splash of grenadine at the end.
The name of the drink derives from one of the co-inventors: James Ed Howard Jr. His partners of the creation were his cousins Colton McArthur, Cooper McArthur, Caden McArthur, Thomas Gross, Benjamin Gross, and James Gross.
Howard invented the drink, with the help of his cousins, at the age of 24, and it has grown in popularity since then.
The James Howard serves as a tasty, refreshing drink for people of all ages.
